report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show successful 200 responses across checkout, order, inventory, and payment; order metrics show v1.0.0 serving /v1/orders with 200s and zero 502s, while v2.0.0 shows zero traffic. Deployments list only baseline v1.0.0. No checkout errors are observed, so no bounded root-cause candidate can be established; more evidence is required.
missing_evidence: Error/failed-span telemetry or logs showing actual checkout errors (current traces show only HTTP 200 successes)
Deployment history for order service beyond baseline v1.0.0, including any v2.0.0 rollout timing and status
Metrics for checkout route error rates and status codes (5xx) to confirm the reported checkout errors
Evidence linking any deployment change to observed error onset
